parameters.note: Grass Lake Creek is a small, USGS-gauged perennial stream (three USGS gauges: 'Grass Lake CK Trib Abv Hwy 89 NR Luther Pass,' 'Grass Lake CK Trib W Abv Hwy 89,' and the main-stem 'Grass Lake CK at Hwy 89 NR Myers,' all in El Dorado Co.) that drains Grass Lake bog near Luther Pass and joins the Upper Truckee River near Christmas Valley/Meyers, at the very top of the Upper Truckee River watershed. It is a distinct named feature from the standing-water lake feature 'Grass Lake' (a different Grass Lake, in the Desolation Wilderness near Fallen Leaf Lake, already covered separately in this dataset). Grass Lake Creek is not listed by name in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b). The only special listing in the vicinity, §7.50(b)(161) 'Upper Truckee River and tributaries upstream from confluence with Showers Creek,' does not extend to Grass Lake Creek: Showers Creek joins the Upper Truckee River far upstream, within the Meiss Meadows headwater basin (~9,000 ft elevation, near the river's source below Red Lake Peak), whereas Grass Lake Creek's confluence with the Upper Truckee River is much farther downstream, near Christmas Valley (~6,500-7,900 ft elevation). Grass Lake Creek therefore falls under the general statewide stream regulation, CCR §5.85(a)(2).
